column2: Before entry: previous report, equipment file, checklist; pockets emptied, self-screened; only marked non-magnetic tools
Safety: 5 gauss line marking, signage, oxygen monitor status, quench pipe outlet (if accessible), emergency buttons labelled, no ferromagnetic items in the room
Staff interview: changes since last visit, artefact complaints, interrupted exams, noise changes, status of previous recommendations
Cryogenics: helium level, magnet pressure, compressor pressures, cold head hours, last cold head and adsorber service dates, frost or condensation, cold head sound
Event log: exported, compared with last visit, recurring and first-in-cascade errors noted
Room and infrastructure: lesson 5 checklist completed
Compressor: air filter or condenser cleaned / water strainer and flow checked per manufacturer
Cooling cabinet and chiller: readings recorded, filters checked, no leaks
Magnet covers: intact, fastened, no liquid traces, no rattles
Patient environment: call bulb, two-way intercom, headphones, bore light, bore fan, bore clear and undamaged
Table: full travel in all axes, smooth and quiet, position indication correct, manual release works freely
Tabletop, built-in coil connectors, cushions, straps; detachable table or trolley docking, brakes and MR labelling
Every coil by type and serial number: housing, cable, connector, latches, recognised by system, coil test or phantom scan passed
Any coil with heat marks, cracks or unreliable recognition taken out of use, labelled, reported in writing
Manufacturer's system tests and image quality test with the standard phantom, values recorded
Configuration and calibration backup done or date verified; free disk space recorded; PACS transfer working
Close-out: no active errors, test scan, room clean, site logbook entry, report with findings and owners, verbal handover to person in charge

column1: Decision: in service / restricted / out of service
